items.title: Genus-two SL2 PI=WI through a universal bundle on the quasi-etale cover and a tautological class of perversity two and weight four
items.difficulty_reason: After the named GIT, Kempf descent, eigenline, decomposition, relative hard Lefschetz and mixed-Hodge inputs and old2102 compactification are allowed, the author still constructs the scalar-cancelling H-linearized eigenline lambda(E) on the specific equivariant parameter space and extends it across the codimension-two complement to descend a universal Higgs family (1620-1648). The resulting projective c2 is detected on nilpotent components and related to spectral-fibre restrictions; its exact perversity-two position requires the coupled degree-four/degree-six dimension and Lefschetz contradiction with the vanishing intersection form (2192-2262), rather than following from a single quoted theorem. These linked, source-specific geometric constructions and filtration constraints support one H3 framework. The final invariant/variant PI=WI closure, numerical polynomial calculations, external adapted arguments and weight input are supplied as parts of that same unit, not counted or used separately to inflate difficulty.

problems.title: Projective relative compactification of Hodge moduli for principal bundles of a complex reductive group on a compact Riemann surface
problems.difficulty_reason: The named Simpson properness theorem does not itself construct a projective compactification of the whole Hodge family. Section3 builds the parameter-compatible equivariant quotient, identifies its open Hodge moduli locus and controls the descended line bundle on the zero fiber by the compactified Hitchin map. The boundary twist and comparison with the trivial nonzero-parameter family then close relative ampleness; these source-specific constructions remain required after the cited GIT and ampleness foundations are allowed.

editorial_notes: The selected PI=WI target is M=M_Dol(C,SL2), C compact of genus2, untwisted degree0, rank2, trivial determinant and trace-free Higgs field, rational intersection cohomology. It is not an assertion for arbitrary genus/rank or ordinary cohomology of the singular space.
Keep P_k IH*(M)=Psi* W_{2k} IH*(M_B) and Gamma=Pic^0(C)[2] invariant/variant splitting, exact perverse shifts, chi-ample alpha, and distinction from ordinary cohomology of the symplectic resolution.

The quasi-etale cover M_iota and its smooth locus carry equivariant Higgs bundles with hyperelliptic involution, six Weierstrass points and trace(h_w)=0. Those auxiliary conditions are not added as restrictions on every point of the target M.

The projective bundle R is on M_iota^sm, its Gamma_iota-invariant class is identified with IH^4(M)^Gamma; do not claim a universal bundle on M itself or replace intersection cohomology by ordinary cohomology.

General complex reductive G and any compact Riemann surface belong to support Theorem3.8; its square commutes up to isotopy, with cohomological commutativity, and symplectic choice only for GLn/SLn, (g,n)=(1,n) or(2,2). GL/PGL/genus-one consequences are support, not separate new claims.

Keep full2441-line fixed work, Sections6.2.4-6.2.6 equivariant parameter space/nilpotent components and externally adapted universal families, Section7 resolution splitting, all Poincare/E-polynomial definitions, exact Gamma action and Section8 complete invariant/variant proof. Old2102 and Theorem3.8 are credited inputs, not new repeated units.
